disabledPlaceholder: The assistant is not available in this context.
composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
empty: Ask about your releases, statements, system status, or this page.
confirmPending: The assistant prepared a change. Confirm to apply it.

pageDescription: Configure the assistant, test models independently, and review token usage and diagnostics.

admin.keyAcceptedHint: The key is verified when the live test passes.
admin.runTestHint: Run a connection test to verify NVIDIA.
admin.unverifiedWarning: NVIDIA is configured but no live test has passed yet. Configuration alone does not prove authentication.
admin.modelsDescription: Configuration and tested capabilities are separate. A model can be configured even when a capability has not been verified.
admin.fallbackHint: Optional. Used once when the reasoning model times out or returns no answer, before any tool round. Only models with a passed connection test are eligible.
admin.healthDescription: Fast and reasoning models are tested independently. One model timing out does not hide the other model's results.
admin.noHealthYet: No connection test has been run yet.
admin.diagnosticsDescription: Recent failed or aborted turns. Confirmed fields come from stored events; hypotheses are not presented as facts.
admin.usageTruncated: The event list is truncated at 20,000 rows. Totals cover the newest rows only.
admin.reportCopyFailed: The diagnostic report could not be copied.
admin.notConfiguredHint: Add the NVIDIA API key under Admin → API Keys.

credits.title: AI Credits
credits.description: 1 credit equals €0.001 of estimated AI costs. Artists share a credit balance. Prices are in euros per million tokens. Existing token limits remain active until credit enforcement is enabled.
credits.extraModel: Price an additional chat model for switching providers
credits.freeTierConfirmed: Zero pricing explicitly confirmed for this provider/account
credits.costDescription: Provider costs and internal credits from finalized transactions.
credits.recentDescription: The latest 30 reservations with their actual provider costs and calculated credits.
credits.adjustDescription: Credits and corrections apply to the current UTC month. The reason and admin ID are recorded.
credits.accountsDescription: Usage includes active reservations. Calculated from account balances, not limited to 5,000 events.
credits.databaseUnavailable: Credit database unavailable. Apply supabase/reset.sql first.

admin.enableDescription: Enable or disable the assistant for allowed roles.
admin.testModeDescription: Use a simulated provider to test without calling a real model.
admin.streamingDescription: Show answers as they are generated rather than after completion.
admin.accessDescription: Enable roles separately. Data permissions are still enforced on the server.
admin.artistAccessDescription: Access within the artist's own context.
admin.advancedSettingsTitle: Advanced settings: performance, reasoning and timeouts
admin.lowEffortDescription: Reduce reasoning effort when supported by the selected model.
admin.testSkippedDetail: Not run because an earlier check failed.
admin.testIntegrationFailed: At least one required check failed. Review the failed steps above.
admin.testInvalidKey: The provider rejected the API key. Check it under Admin → API Keys.
admin.testNoKey: No API key is stored for this provider. Add it under Admin → API Keys.
admin.testModelUnavailable: The provider does not offer this model. Choose another in the Models tab.
admin.testToolsUnsupported: The model did not return a valid tool call. Text replies may still work, but assistant tool actions are unreliable. Test a different model.
admin.testTimeout: The provider did not respond within the test timeout. Retry or choose another model.
admin.testRateLimited: The provider is currently limiting requests. Retry later or review your provider quota.
admin.testEmptyResponse: The model returned no usable response. Retry or choose another model.
admin.testIncompleteResponse: The model reply was incomplete. Check the model and output token limits.
admin.testProviderUnavailable: The model provider is currently unavailable. Check its status and retry.
admin.testNetworkError: The connection to the model provider failed. Check the network and provider status.
admin.testInvalidResponse: The provider returned an invalid response. Check the model and retry.
admin.testUnknownError: The check failed. Expand technical details for its error code.

turnInProgress: Another answer is still running. Stop it before sending a new question.
